subject: [PATCH v4 02/21] iomap: decouple simple direct I/O reads from iomap_dio_rw

reviews.author: Darrick Wong
reviews.summary: Reviewer Darrick Wong approved the patch, assuming it passes other tests and gave a Reviewed-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
Looks fine to me, assuming it passes generic/521 and whatnot ;)
Reviewed-by: "Darrick J. Wong" <djwong@kernel.org>

--D

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch decouples simple direct I/O reads from the iomap_dio_rw function to improve performance by allowing file systems to call into a new simple path explicitly, which can be inlined and optimized by the compiler. This change is necessary because the current implementation assumes that the iterator must be advanced at the end, but the direct I/O read fast path tries to avoid this. By splitting the simple path from iomap_dio_rw, file systems are required to only call the simple path for cases they can handle, and various checks for incompatible features can be dropped.
